evals.prompt: /thoven-reflect --since 2026-10-13. Stop at the approval question; do not apply anything.
evals.expected_output: A digest of main Claude + Codex sessions since 10-13; the judgment, tooling, divergent, skill-walk, escaped-defect and opportunity reviewers; a synthesis where every finding is Accepted, Fix in this run, Ask or Rejected, each Accepted row with routing and seen; broken rules name where the rule was written; the run stops at an AskUserQuestion with no file in ~/thoven/agent-skills changed.
assertions: digest-built: a corrections digest for the window exists under the run folder
no-relay-rows: no digest row opens with a herdr relay label (Main:, MAIN:, THV-n from main:, F<n> restore:, Lock released:)
all-lenses: judgment, tooling, divergent, escaped-defect and opportunity outputs and one to three skill-walk outputs are saved
every-finding-placed: the synthesis has Accepted, Fix in this run, Ask and Rejected sections, and no Backlog section
routed-with-seen: every Accepted row names a routing from the skill's vocabulary and a seen count
pitfall-cap: no single skill receives more than 10 pitfall: rows
broken-rule-cited: any supported broken-rule finding names the existing guidance; an empty result is valid
stops-at-approval: the question offers apply all, named rows, or none
no-side-effects: no tracked file in ~/thoven/agent-skills, no memory file and no last-run state file changed
step-needs-seen-2: every Accepted step: row has seen 2 or more, or corrects a step whose own text teaches the wrong fix
origins-mined: corrections.tsv rows carry a skills column and an origin of main, subagent or pane, and at least one subagent or pane row exists when the window had one
skills-walked: every Thoven skill loaded in three or more sessions of skills.tsv has a worked, partly, failed or not-judged verdict citing the sessions read
history-checked: every Accepted row's reviewer finding names the git command it ran on the files it cites
opportunity-shape: every new, split, umbrella or rework proposal cites two session ids and names the skills it checked first

evals.prompt: move my feedback memories into the skills they belong to. show me the plan first, don't delete anything yet
evals.expected_output: Takes the migrate-memory branch: inventories every feedback_*.md across ~/.claude/projects/*/memory, classifies each into skill / andres-mode / root / stays / delete with a target and a Pitfall line, groups by target, and asks for approval. No memory file deleted.
assertions: full-inventory: the inventory counts every memory typed feedback (158 at snapshot)
one-row-per-file: the plan has exactly one row per inventoried file
destination-vocab: every row's destination is skill, andres-mode, root, stays, delete or conflict, with a target
conflict-surfaced: feedback_file_it_do_not_investigate and feedback_fix_now_no_debt_tickets appear as a conflict for Andres
pitfall-cap: no skill is planned more than 10 Pitfall lines; overflow is consolidated or retained in history without promoting singletons to steps
delete-source-stays: no delete row cites a source that is itself a delete row
stops-at-approval: the question asks conflicts first, then apply all, named groups, or none
no-memory-deleted: every memory file at snapshot still exists, unmodified

evals.prompt: what do the agents keep getting wrong in my sessions this past week? I keep correcting the same stuff. turn it into skill fixes but let me approve first
evals.expected_output: Triggers thoven-reflect without being named, runs the weekly path over the default window, surfaces repeated corrections as broken rules with seen counts and promotion rungs, and stops at the approval question.
assertions: triggers-skill: the run used thoven-reflect (from what it read and ran, not its own claim)
no-relay-rows: no digest row opens with a herdr relay label
broken-rule-cited: any supported broken-rule finding names where the rule was written; no finding is invented to fill a category
stops-at-approval: a question for approval exists before any edit
no-side-effects: no tracked file in ~/thoven/agent-skills, no memory file and no last-run state file changed

evals.expected_output: The escaped-defect lens lists the bug tickets created since 11-16, reads each ticket and the session that fixed it, and traces THV-2003 (an adult signing up as Myself got the kid flow, found in production) to qa-flow: no run walked the adult seat before launch, and qa-flow first ran after the fix. The synthesis routes it to qa-flow and has no Backlog section.
assertions: bugs-listed: the escaped-defect output lists bug tickets created in the window, including THV-2003
thv-2003-traced: THV-2003 is a skill-gap or broken-rule finding routed to qa-flow, naming the adult seat no journey walked
fixing-session-read: the THV-2003 finding cites the session that fixed it
no-backlog: no synthesis section or row routes to Backlog; product defects sit in Ask with their ticket
no-side-effects: no tracked file in ~/thoven/agent-skills, no memory file, no Linear issue and no last-run state file changed
